title: Caffeine Cutoff Breach by Beverage
dataSources: Alcohol habit events (`habit:alcohol`), caffeine intake (`habit:caffeine`), screen-time sessions (`habit:screen`), and fasting windows (`habit:fasting`).
app: Habit-boundary telemetry for Dry January, caffeine cutoffs, screen-before-bed limits, and fasting windows sent to Splunk HEC via apps, shortcuts, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=habit:caffeine
| search cutoff_breach=true
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as breaches avg(caffeine_mg) as avg_caffeine_mg by _time beverage_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks caffeine cutoff breaches over time and breaks it out by beverage.
value: Breach counts by beverage reveal whether the problem is one favorite drink or the whole routine.
implementation: Send caffeine cutoff breaches events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of caffeine cutoff breaches by beverage.
grandmaExplanation: It records how caffeine cutoff breaches changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
